name: The Ruined Menagerie
introDiscord:
The royal menagerie spreads across overgrown enclosures and ornamental
ponds.

Most cages are open.

Shizuki has named several creatures.

None of them were consulted.

the-ruined-menagerie-approach.prompt: The Ruined Menagerie opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message:
A keeper's station contains restorative supplies.

Shizuki wrote:

'Met Mr. Fluff.

Mr. Fluff has seventeen teeth.

Name remains appropriate.'
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: A Crown-Caged Chimera emerges from the enclosure.

forward.message: A keeper's coffer contains Star Candies.

the-ruined-menagerie-depths.prompt: Deeper within The Ruined Menagerie, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message:
One Berry rests beneath a creature list:

'Mr. Fluff
Bitey
Sir Shellington
Princess Screams-A-Lot

Glimmer rejected all names.

Glimmer lacks imagination.'

right.message: An old feeding chest contains Star Candies.

forward.message: A Chimera leaps across the ruined enclosure.
